_doc: The Maple Terraces props, generated by a script (yaw degrees, 0 faces +z north, 90 faces +x east). The main garden is viewed as in the concept, through the torii at (252, 929.5) looking north: raked gravel court x 222-272 z 942-990, temple at (246, 1006), the pagoda behind it on the upper terrace to the east, the koi pond and red bridge at (212, 958) on the west, the bamboo fence along x 197.5 with the grove behind it. zen_terrace_wall rows are placed where the baked terrain drops (rings and terrace fronts).
